summary: Construction project tracking application with RAP/RAB management, unlimited nested sub-jobs, multi-stage approval workflow (Foreman → Buyer → Finance), realization reporting, complete accounting system (journals, ledger, balance sheet, P&L, cash flow, budget vs actual), progress tracking with S-Curve visualization, and role-based access control (Admin, Foreman/Mandor, Buyer, Finance)
architectural_notes: Frontend: React + TypeScript with Tailwind CSS for modern UI
Backend: Motoko on Internet Computer for decentralized deployment
Authentication: Internet Identity for secure, passwordless login
Unlimited nested job hierarchy requires recursive data structures
Multi-stage approval workflow with partial approval tracking
Accounting system generates automatic journal entries from approval and realization data
S-Curve calculations based on main job progress dates vs planned timeline
Role-based permission system controls access to features and data visibility

existing_features.title: Implement user authentication system with Internet Identity supporting four roles: Admin, Foreman (Mandor), Buyer, and Finance with role-based access control
Create master data management system for Materials (name, unit, price), Jobs/Pekerjaan, and Vendors/Suppliers with CRUD operations
Implement RAP (Rencana Anggaran Pelaksanaan) and RAB (Rencana Anggaran Biaya) creation system with unlimited nested sub-job structure where each level has its own volume, unit, and separate cost
Create master RAP template system that allows users to save reusable RAP structures and apply existing templates to new projects
Implement material/fund request workflow where Foreman selects a main job (automatically including all sub-jobs and materials) to create a request
Implement Buyer review and approval stage where Buyer can view requests from Foreman, edit quantities and prices, and approve partially with remaining amounts tracked for future requests
Implement Finance review and approval stage where Finance receives data from Buyer, can edit and approve partially, with final approval completing the workflow
Implement realization report system where Buyer inputs actual prices from invoices/receipts after Finance approval is complete
Implement comprehensive accounting system with automatic journal entries, general ledger, balance sheet, profit and loss statement, cash flow report, and budget vs actual comparison per job
Implement progress tracking system where progress dates are recorded for main jobs to generate S-Curve data
Implement S-Curve visualization showing timeline progress versus planned schedule based on main jobs with interactive chart
Create role-specific dashboards for Admin, Foreman, Buyer, and Finance showing relevant overview, summaries, and pending items for each role
Implement material usage tracking where Buyer can view total materials used against requests when additional requests are submitted

Design and implement a creative, cohesive visual theme with distinct style (colors, typography, layout) suitable for a professional construction project management application, avoiding blue and purple color schemes
